d: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 in El Clasico in La Liga, his second a late winner to take him to 100 goals for the club. Meanwhile, Jose Mourinho has revitalised Los Blancos after a rough start to the series. All this came on the night of the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London. What does this milestone tell us about how far Mbappe has come at Real Madrid? Rupha Ramani on his El Clasico night and what conversation it sets for the Ballon d’Or 2026 night.
